band_pull_apart.title: Band Pull-Apart
band_pull_apart.desc: Pull a band apart to your chest to strengthen your upper back and keep your shoulders open.
steps: Stand tall and hold a band in front of you with straight arms at shoulder height.
Pull the band apart by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Touch the band to your chest, then return slowly.
Do 12 reps and rest, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears.
Letting the band snap back instead of returning slowly.
band_pull_apart.tip: Choose a band light enough to finish every rep with good form, and check it for tears first.

steps: Grip the bar overhand, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lift your feet and let your body hang straight and relaxed.
Keep your shoulders slightly engaged and breathe slowly for 30 seconds.
Step down gently, rest 30 to 60 seconds, and repeat for 3 sets.
mistakes: Swinging or kicking your legs while hanging.
Dropping off the bar instead of stepping down.
bar_hanging.tip: Start with shorter holds and add a few seconds each week.

bird_dog.title: Bird Dog
bird_dog.desc: Reach your opposite arm and leg long to train the deep muscles that keep your spine steady.
steps: Start on all fours, hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg straight back.
Hold for two seconds with your hips level, then return.
Do 8 reps, switch sides, and do 2 sets on each side.
mistakes: Letting the lower back sag as the leg lifts.
Rotating the hips open to raise the leg higher.
bird_dog.tip: Imagine a glass of water resting on your lower back that must not spill.

bow_pose.title: Bow Pose
bow_pose.desc: Hold your ankles and lift your chest and thighs to open your whole front and strengthen your back.
steps: Lie face down and bend your knees so your heels come toward your hips.
Reach back and hold both ankles.
Kick your feet into your hands to lift your chest and thighs.
Hold 10 seconds and lower slowly, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Letting the knees spread wider than the hips.
Throwing the head back and straining the neck.
bow_pose.tip: Lift only as high as feels comfortable, and skip this one if your lower back hurts.

broad_jumps.title: Broad Jumps
broad_jumps.desc: Jump forward off two feet and stick the landing to build hip power and strong leg bones.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your toes behind a line.
Swing your arms back, bend your knees and push your hips back.
Swing your arms forward, jump as far as you can and land on both feet.
Hold the landing for a second, walk back and do 5 jumps, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Falling forward or backward on the landing.
Landing with your knees locked straight.
broad_jumps.tip: Jump on a surface that does not slip, and jump shorter until you can hold every landing still.

burpees.title: Burpees
burpees.desc: Squat, plank and jump in one move, whole-body work your body answers with growth hormone afterwards.
steps: Stand tall, then squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a straight plank.
Jump your feet back in toward your hands.
Jump straight up, do 5 reps and rest, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag in the plank.
Landing hard with straight legs after the jump.
burpees.tip: Step your feet back and in instead of jumping to make it easier, and slow down if your form slips.

calf_pulses.title: Calf Pulses
calf_pulses.desc: Small tiptoe bounces that keep your calves working and build strong lower legs.
steps: Stand tall and rise onto your tiptoes, fingertips on a wall if you need balance.
Bounce up and down in small pulses, just a few centimetres.
Keep your heels off the floor for the whole set.
Keep going for 20 seconds, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Letting your heels touch the floor between pulses.
Making the movement so big that it stops being a pulse.
calf_pulses.tip: A burn in your calves is normal. Sharp pain means stop.

calf_raise.title: Calf Raise
calf_raise.desc: Rise onto your toes to build strong calves and ankles for jumping and running.
steps: Stand tall next to a wall, fingertips touching it for balance.
Rise slowly onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Hold 1 second at the top, then lower your heels slowly.
Do 15 reps per set, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Bouncing quickly instead of moving slowly.
Letting your ankles roll outward at the top.
calf_raise.tip: Do them while brushing your teeth for an easy daily habit.

cat_cow.title: Cat-Cow
cat_cow.desc: Flow between arching and rounding your back to move your whole spine.
steps: Start on hands and knees, wrists under shoulders, knees under hips.
Breathe in, drop your belly and lift your chest and gaze (cow).
Breathe out, round your back and tuck your chin (cat).
Move slowly with your breath for 10 rounds, 2 sets.
mistakes: Moving faster than your breathing.
Moving only your neck instead of your whole spine.
cat_cow.tip: Great as your first move in the morning or a reset after sitting.

chest_stretch.title: Doorway Chest Stretch
chest_stretch.desc: Step through a doorway with your forearm on the frame to open a chest rounded by screens.
steps: Stand in a doorway and place one forearm on the frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step the same-side foot forward through the doorway.
Lean your chest forward until you feel a stretch across the front of your shoulder.
Hold 20 seconds, switch sides, and do 2 sets on each side.
mistakes: Arching the lower back to lean further.
Shrugging the shoulder up toward the ear.
chest_stretch.tip: Keep the stretch gentle, and back off if you feel a pinch in your shoulder.

childs_pose.title: Child's Pose
childs_pose.desc: Sit back on your heels with long arms to gently stretch your back and let your spine relax.
steps: Kneel on the floor with your big toes together and your knees apart.
Sit your hips back onto your heels.
Walk your hands forward and rest your forehead on the floor.
Breathe slowly for 30 seconds and come up, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Lifting the hips far off the heels to reach further.
Holding the breath and tensing the shoulders.
childs_pose.tip: Put a cushion between your hips and heels if your knees feel tight.

chin_tucks.title: Chin Tucks
chin_tucks.desc: Slide your chin straight back to ease a forward head and improve your neck posture.
steps: Sit or stand tall and look straight ahead.
Slide your chin straight back, as if making a double chin.
Hold 3 seconds, then relax.
Do 8 reps per set, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Nodding your head down instead of sliding it back.
Pushing so hard that your neck hurts.
chin_tucks.tip: Do a few every time you put your phone down.

steps: Lie face down with your hands flat under your shoulders.
Press the floor away and lift your chest slowly, hips stay down.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and shoulders away from your ears.
Hold 15 seconds, breathing slowly, then lower down with control.
mistakes: Pushing up so high that your lower back pinches.
Shrugging your shoulders up toward your ears.
cobra_stretch.tip: Lift only as high as feels comfortable; it deepens with practice.

dead_bug.title: Dead Bug
dead_bug.desc: Lower your opposite arm and leg with your back flat to build core control that protects your spine.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms straight up and your knees bent above your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lower one arm overhead and the opposite leg toward the floor, then return.
Do 8 reps on each side and rest, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Letting the lower back arch off the floor.
Rushing through the reps.
dead_bug.tip: Lower your arm and leg only as far as your back can stay flat on the floor.

dead_hang_active.title: Active Hang
dead_hang_active.desc: Hang from a bar with engaged shoulders to build grip and shoulder control.
steps: Grip the bar overhand, hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Hang with straight arms, then pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Keep your legs together and core tight, and hold for 20 seconds.
Step down gently and rest 40 seconds between sets.
mistakes: Bending your elbows like a pull-up.
Shrugging your shoulders up to your ears.
dead_hang_active.tip: Think of pushing the bar away from you to feel your shoulders work.

steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees softly bent.
Hinge at your hips and slide your hands down your thighs.
Keep your back flat and reach toward your toes until your hamstrings stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up, 12 slow reps per set.
mistakes: Rounding your back to reach lower.
Locking your knees completely straight.
deadlift_stretch.tip: Move slowly; control matters more than how far you reach.

downward_dog.title: Downward Dog
downward_dog.desc: An upside-down V that stretches your shoulders, back and calves for a more open posture.
steps: Start on hands and knees, hands under your shoulders.
Lift your hips high so your body makes an upside-down V.
Keep your spine long and let your heels sink toward the floor.
Hold 20 seconds and rest, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Rounding your back to force your heels down.
Shrugging your shoulders up to your ears.
downward_dog.tip: Bend your knees a little if your back rounds. Your heels do not need to touch the floor.

dumbbell_deadlift.title: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
dumbbell_deadlift.desc: Hinge at your hips with a flat back, hard big-muscle work your body answers with growth hormone afterwards.
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and push your hips back with a flat back.
Slide the weights down your thighs to just below your knees.
Squeeze your glutes to stand up, do 8 reps, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Rounding the back as the weights go down.
Turning it into a squat by bending the knees a lot.
dumbbell_deadlift.tip: Pick a weight light enough to finish every rep with good form.

dumbbell_row.title: Dumbbell Row
dumbbell_row.desc: Pull a dumbbell to your hip to build the upper-back muscles that draw your shoulders back.
steps: Place one hand on a bench or chair and step your feet back.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand with your back flat and your arm hanging down.
Pull the weight to your hip with your elbow close, then lower it slowly.
Do 8 reps on each side and rest, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Twisting the body to heave the weight up.
Shrugging the shoulder toward the ear.
dumbbell_row.tip: Pick a weight light enough to finish every rep with good form.

steps: Start on hands and knees and flow through cat-cow for 60 seconds.
Sit back into child's pose, arms long, and breathe for 60 seconds.
Press up into downward dog, heels reaching toward the floor.
Stand and fold forward, letting your head hang heavy.
Breathe in for 4 counts and out for 6 counts in every pose.
mistakes: Rushing between poses instead of holding them.
Forcing a pose until it hurts.
evening_yoga.tip: Dim the lights while you flow to help your body wind down.

farmer_carry.title: Farmer's Carry
farmer_carry.desc: Walk tall with a weight in each hand, whole-body work the body answers with growth hormone afterwards.
steps: Stand between two dumbbells or two loaded bags.
Bend your knees, keep your back flat and pick them up.
Walk with small steps, shoulders back and eyes forward.
Walk for 20 seconds, set them down and rest, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Leaning to one side or letting the shoulders round forward.
Rounding the back when picking up or putting down the weights.
farmer_carry.tip: Pick a weight light enough to finish every set with good form, and keep both sides equal.

glute_bridge.title: Glute Bridge
glute_bridge.desc: Lift your hips to strengthen your glutes and open up hips that feel tight from sitting.
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart.
Press through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for 2 seconds.
Lower slowly, 12 reps per set, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Pushing through your toes instead of your heels.
Overarching your lower back at the top.
glute_bridge.tip: If you feel it in your glutes, not your lower back, you are doing it right.

goblet_squat.title: Goblet Squat
goblet_squat.desc: Squat with a weight at your chest, the big-muscle effort your body answers with growth hormone afterwards.
steps: Hold one dumbbell or a loaded backpack against your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes turned out a little.
Sit down between your heels with your chest up, then stand back up.
Do 8 reps and rest, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Letting the knees cave inward.
Rounding the back and letting the chest drop.
goblet_squat.tip: Pick a weight light enough to finish every rep with good form.

hanging_knee_raise.title: Hanging Knee Raise
hanging_knee_raise.desc: Lift your knees while you hang to build a strong core as the hang decompresses your spine.
steps: Grip the bar overhand and hang with straight arms.
Pull your shoulders down away from your ears.
Lift both knees to hip height without swinging, then lower them slowly.
Do 5 reps, step down and rest, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Swinging the body to throw the knees up.
Hanging with the shoulders up by the ears.
hanging_knee_raise.tip: Check that the bar is solid before you hang, and step down instead of dropping off.

high_knees.title: High Knees
high_knees.desc: Run on the spot with your knees at hip height to warm up fast and load your legs.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Run on the spot and lift each knee to hip height.
Pump your arms and stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for 20 seconds, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Leaning back as your knees come up.
Stomping the floor with flat feet.
high_knees.tip: Slow it down to a march with high knees if you get out of breath.

steps: Warm up for 3 minutes with marching in place and arm circles.
Do burpees, mountain climbers and jump squats, 45 seconds each.
Rest 15 seconds between moves and breathe deeply.
Complete 4 rounds, then walk slowly until your breathing settles.
mistakes: Letting your form slip to go faster.
Holding your breath during the hard intervals.
hiit_workout.tip: Go at your own pace; finishing all 4 rounds beats a fast start.

hip_flexor_stretch.title: Hip Flexor Stretch
hip_flexor_stretch.desc: Open the front of your hips to ease the tightness from long hours of sitting.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front of you.
Tuck your hips under slightly and squeeze the glute of your back leg.
Shift forward gently until you feel a stretch at the front of your hip.
Hold 30 seconds, breathing slowly, then switch sides.
mistakes: Arching your lower back instead of tucking your hips.
Letting your front knee drift past your toes.
hip_flexor_stretch.tip: Put a folded towel under your knee to make it more comfortable.

steps: Only invert with an adult supervising and on stable, checked equipment.
Lock your ankles securely and start at a slight incline, not fully upside down.
Relax your arms and breathe slowly for up to 1 minute.
Return upright slowly and sit for a moment before standing.
Stop right away if you feel dizzy, pressure in your head or any pain.
mistakes: Going fully upside down in your first sessions.
Standing up quickly right after inverting.
inversion_hang.tip: Short, gentle sessions are enough; there is no need to hang longer.

jump_squats.title: Jump Squats
jump_squats.desc: Squat and jump for leg power, the hard big-muscle work your body answers with growth hormone afterwards.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your chest up.
Sit back into a squat until your thighs are about level with the floor.
Push hard through your feet, jump straight up and land softly back in the squat.
Do 8 jumps, rest, and repeat for 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Letting your knees cave inward on the landing.
Landing with stiff, straight legs.
jump_squats.tip: Land as quietly as you can, and stop the set when your landings get loud.

steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
Bend your knees, swing your arms and jump straight up.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with knees slightly bent.
Do 20 jumps, rest 30 seconds, and repeat for 3 sets.
mistakes: Landing stiff-legged on your heels.
Letting your knees cave inward on landing.
jumping.tip: Quiet landings mean good control, so try to land like a cat.

knee_circles.title: Knee Circles
knee_circles.desc: Gentle circles that warm up your knees and ankles before you move.
steps: Stand with your feet together and bend your knees slightly.
Put your hands on your knees.
Make small, slow circles with your knees for 15 seconds one way.
Switch direction and go 15 seconds the other way.
mistakes: Making big circles that twist your knees.
Doing all your circles in one direction.
knee_circles.tip: Use it as a warm-up before jumps or running.

legs_up_wall.title: Legs Up the Wall
legs_up_wall.desc: Rest your legs up a wall to take the load off your spine and unwind after a long day.
steps: Sit sideways next to a wall with one hip touching it.
Swing your legs up the wall as you lie back on the floor.
Let your arms rest by your sides and relax your legs against the wall.
Stay for 3 minutes, breathing slowly.
mistakes: Lifting the lower back off the floor.
Locking the knees hard and tensing the legs.
legs_up_wall.tip: Move your hips a little away from the wall if the back of your legs feels tight.

low_lunge_arch.title: Low Lunge with Reach
low_lunge_arch.desc: Sink your hips forward and reach up to open the front of your hips and your chest.
steps: Step one foot forward and lower your back knee to the floor.
Slide your hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Reach both arms up and lift your chest into a gentle arch.
Hold 20 seconds, switch legs, and do 2 sets on each side.
mistakes: Letting the front knee travel far past the toes.
Bending only from the lower back.
low_lunge_arch.tip: Put a folded towel under your back knee, and keep the arch small.

lunges.title: Lunges
lunges.desc: Step forward and bend both knees to build strong legs and hips, one side at a time.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Take a big step forward and lower until both knees bend to about 90 degrees.
Push through your front heel to step back to the start.
Do 8 reps on each leg and rest, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Letting the front knee cave inward.
Leaning the chest far forward over the front leg.
lunges.tip: Take a shorter step or hold a chair for balance until the movement feels steady.

masai_jumps.title: Masai Jumps
masai_jumps.desc: Small springy jumps with an upright body build strong legs and stronger bones.
steps: Stand tall with your arms by your sides or reaching up.
Make small, springy jumps and keep your body upright the whole time.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, knees slightly bent.
Keep going for 20 seconds, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Landing hard on your heels.
Slumping forward as you get tired.
masai_jumps.tip: Stop if your knees or shins hurt, and rest before you try again.

steps: Stand tall and roll your neck slowly, 5 circles each way.
Reach both arms overhead, interlace your fingers and stretch up for 30 seconds.
Bend forward from your hips and let your hands hang toward your toes.
Step into a lunge, hold 30 seconds, then switch legs.
Breathe slowly through your nose and never bounce into a stretch.
mistakes: Bouncing to go deeper instead of holding still.
Holding your breath during the hold.
morning_stretch.tip: Stretch before you check your phone and the habit sticks faster.

mountain_pose.title: Mountain Pose on Toes
mountain_pose.desc: Rise onto your toes and reach up to lengthen your spine and practise standing at your full height.
steps: Stand with your feet together and your weight even on both feet.
Reach both arms straight overhead with your palms facing each other.
Rise onto your toes and stretch up through your fingertips.
Hold 20 seconds and lower slowly, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Flaring your ribs and arching your lower back.
Shrugging your shoulders up to your ears.
mountain_pose.tip: Fix your eyes on one point in front of you, or keep your heels down if you wobble.

steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and down.
Tilt your ear slowly toward one shoulder and hold 30 seconds per side.
Lower your chin toward your chest and hold for 30 seconds.
Lift your gaze gently for 30 seconds without dropping your head back.
mistakes: Pulling hard on your head with your hand.
Lifting your shoulder up to meet your ear.
neck_stretches.tip: Do these after long study sessions to release tension.

steps: Stand tall holding light weights or water bottles at shoulder height.
Brace your core and press both arms straight overhead.
Finish with arms beside your ears, then lower slowly to your shoulders.
Breathe out as you press, in as you lower, 10 reps per set.
mistakes: Arching your lower back as you press.
Using weights too heavy to control.
overhead_press.tip: Start with bodyweight and add light weights once your form feels easy.

pelvic_shift.title: Pelvic Shift
pelvic_shift.desc: Lift and lower your hips one vertebra at a time to loosen your spine and wake up your glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Tuck your tailbone and peel your spine off the floor from the bottom up.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly, one vertebra at a time.
Do 10 slow reps and rest, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Pushing the hips up fast in one piece.
Arching the lower back at the top.
pelvic_shift.tip: Move slowly enough to feel each part of your back touch the floor.

steps: Hold a forearm plank for 1 minute, body in one straight line.
Lie on your back for dead bugs, lowering opposite arm and leg slowly.
Switch to bird dog on hands and knees, reaching opposite arm and leg.
Finish with 1 minute of glute bridges and 1 minute of leg raises.
Breathe out every time you tighten your core.
mistakes: Letting your hips sag during the plank.
Arching your lower back off the floor during dead bugs.
pilates_core.tip: Slow and controlled beats fast; every clean rep builds real strength.

pilates_roll_over.title: Pilates Roll Over
pilates_roll_over.desc: Roll your legs overhead and back with control to stretch your spine and train deep core strength.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides and your legs straight up.
Press your arms into the floor and lift your hips to roll your legs overhead.
Stop when your legs are level with the floor behind your head.
Roll back down slowly, do 5 reps and rest, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Swinging the legs over with momentum.
Rolling onto the neck instead of the shoulders.
pilates_roll_over.tip: Keep your weight on your shoulders and never on your neck, and bend your knees to make it easier.

plank.title: Plank
plank.desc: Hold a straight-body plank to build a strong core that supports upright posture.
steps: Place your forearms on the floor, elbows under your shoulders.
Step your feet back so your body forms one straight line.
Squeeze your glutes, pull your belly button in and hold 30 seconds.
Rest 30 seconds and repeat for 3 sets.
mistakes: Letting your hips sag toward the floor.
Piking your hips up too high.
plank.tip: Add 5 seconds each week as it gets easier.

pogo_jumps.title: Pogo Jumps
pogo_jumps.desc: Quick, stiff-ankle bounces load your shin and foot bones and build springy, powerful calves.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Bounce on the balls of your feet with your knees almost straight.
Keep each ground contact short and quick, like a pogo stick.
Keep going for 20 seconds, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Bending your knees deeply on every bounce.
Letting your heels slam into the floor.
pogo_jumps.tip: Jump on a firm, flat surface and stop if your shins or ankles hurt.

steps: Set an hourly reminder to check how you are sitting or standing.
Stack your ears over your shoulders and your shoulders over your hips.
Roll your shoulders back and down, chest gently open.
Imagine a string pulling the top of your head up, then breathe.
mistakes: Overcorrecting with a stiff, arched back.
Looking down at your phone with your head pushed forward.
posture_check.tip: Raise your screen to eye level and good posture becomes automatic.

steps: Start 30 minutes before bed: dim the lights and put screens away.
Read a book or listen to calm music for 15 minutes.
Do 5 minutes of gentle stretching on your bed or the floor.
Breathe in for 4 seconds and out for 6 seconds, 10 rounds.
mistakes: Scrolling on your phone for just one more minute.
Changing your bedtime a lot from night to night.
pre_sleep_routine.tip: Same time, same steps every night makes falling asleep easier.

pull_ups.title: Pull-Ups
pull_ups.desc: Pull your chin over the bar to build your back, hard work the body answers with growth hormone afterwards.
steps: Grip the bar overhand, hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Start from a straight-arm hang and pull your shoulder blades down.
Pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower yourself slowly.
Do 2 reps, step down and rest, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Kicking and swinging to get over the bar.
Dropping down fast instead of lowering with control.
pull_ups.tip: Loop a band under your feet or jump to the top and lower slowly, and check that the bar is solid.

puppy_pose.title: Puppy Pose
puppy_pose.desc: Melt your chest toward the floor to open tight shoulders and stretch your upper back.
steps: Start on all fours with your hips right above your knees.
Walk your hands forward and keep your hips where they are.
Let your chest and forehead sink toward the floor.
Hold 20 seconds and come back up, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Letting the hips slide back toward the heels.
Bending the elbows and resting them on the floor.
puppy_pose.tip: Rest your forehead on a cushion if the stretch in your shoulders feels too strong.

push_ups.title: Push-Ups
push_ups.desc: Lower your chest to the floor with a straight body to build your chest, arms and core.
steps: Place your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders.
Step your feet back so your body forms one straight line.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest to the floor, then push back up.
Do 5 reps and rest, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag toward the floor.
Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides.
push_ups.tip: Drop to your knees or put your hands on a bench to make it easier.

scapular_pull.title: Scapular Pull
scapular_pull.desc: Pull your shoulders down from a hang with straight arms to build the base for strong pull-ups.
steps: Grip the bar overhand, hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Hang with straight arms and let your shoulders rise toward your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades down so your body lifts a little, elbows straight.
Hold a second and release, do 5 reps, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Bending the elbows to pull higher.
Swinging the legs to help.
scapular_pull.tip: Check that the bar is solid, and keep your feet on a box if a full hang is too hard.

scapular_retraction.title: Shoulder Blade Squeeze
scapular_retraction.desc: Squeeze your shoulder blades back and down to train the muscles that keep your shoulders from rounding.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your arms relaxed at your sides.
Pull your shoulder blades back and down, as if tucking them into your back pockets.
Hold the squeeze for one slow breath, then release.
Do 10 reps and rest, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders up while squeezing.
Pushing the ribs forward and arching the back.
scapular_retraction.tip: Keep your chin level and your neck relaxed the whole time.

seated_forward_fold.title: Seated Forward Fold
seated_forward_fold.desc: Hinge forward over straight legs to stretch your hamstrings and the whole length of your back.
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and your toes pointing up.
Sit up tall and reach both arms overhead.
Hinge forward from your hips and reach for your shins or feet.
Hold 20 seconds and sit back up, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Rounding the upper back to reach the toes.
Bouncing to get deeper into the stretch.
seated_forward_fold.tip: Bend your knees a little or sit on a folded towel if your lower back rounds.

steps: Stand tall with your arms hanging loosely at your sides.
Roll your shoulders forward in big circles 15 times.
Roll them backward 15 times, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Clasp your hands behind your back and open your chest for 20 seconds.
mistakes: Making tiny, rushed circles.
Shrugging while holding your breath.
shoulder_rolls.tip: A quick set between classes or study blocks keeps your shoulders open.

side_plank.title: Side Plank
side_plank.desc: Hold a straight line on one forearm to strengthen the side muscles that keep your posture even.
steps: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor, elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips off the floor.
Keep your body in one straight line from head to heels.
Hold 15 seconds, switch sides, and do 2 sets on each side.
mistakes: Letting the hips drop toward the floor.
Rolling the chest forward toward the floor.
side_plank.tip: Keep your bottom knee on the floor to make it easier.

single_leg_calf_raise.title: Single-Leg Calf Raise
single_leg_calf_raise.desc: Rise on one foot from the edge of a step to build strong calves and ankles for jumping.
steps: Stand on the edge of a step on the ball of one foot and hold a wall or rail.
Lower your heel slowly below the level of the step.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes and pause for a second.
Do 8 reps on each leg and rest, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Bouncing out of the bottom instead of moving slowly.
Bending the knee to help the calf.
single_leg_calf_raise.tip: Start with body weight, and if you add a dumbbell or backpack, pick a weight light enough to finish every rep with good form.

single_leg_hops.title: Single-Leg Hops
single_leg_hops.desc: Small hops on one leg strengthen your ankles and bones and even out your two sides.
steps: Stand on one leg with the other foot lifted behind you.
Make small hops on the spot, landing on the ball of your foot.
Keep your hips level and your standing knee slightly bent.
Do 8 hops, switch legs, and do 2 sets on each side.
mistakes: Letting the knee of the hopping leg cave inward.
Hopping so high that you lose your balance.
single_leg_hops.tip: Stay close to a wall you can touch, and keep the hops low until your balance feels steady.

steps: Hold the handles at hip height, elbows close to your sides.
Turn the rope with your wrists, not your whole arms.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope, landing on the balls of your feet.
Skip for 5 minutes, rest 1 minute, and repeat for 3 sets.
mistakes: Jumping too high and tiring out fast.
Landing flat-footed on your heels.
skipping_rope.tip: Tripping is normal; just restart and keep the rhythm going.

spinal_twist.title: Lying Spinal Twist
spinal_twist.desc: Drop one knee across your body to gently rotate your spine and release a stiff lower back.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
Bend one knee and bring it across your body toward the floor.
Keep both shoulders on the floor and look to the opposite side.
Hold 20 seconds, switch sides, and do 2 sets on each side.
mistakes: Letting the opposite shoulder lift off the floor.
Forcing the knee down with the hand.
spinal_twist.tip: Rest your knee on a cushion if it does not reach the floor.

steps: Warm up with 5 minutes of easy jogging and leg swings.
Sprint at full effort for 30 seconds, pumping your arms.
Walk or jog slowly for 90 seconds to recover.
Repeat for 3 sprints, then cool down with 5 minutes of walking.
mistakes: Sprinting without warming up first.
Leaning back and overstriding instead of driving forward.
sprint_intervals.tip: Pick a flat, safe surface and go all out only when you feel fresh.

steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out.
Push your hips back and lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest up and your knees in line with your toes.
Press through your heels to stand, breathing out on the way up.
mistakes: Lifting your heels off the floor.
Rounding your back at the bottom.
squats.tip: Do your first sets in front of a mirror to check your form.

standing_side_stretch.title: Standing Side Stretch
standing_side_stretch.desc: Lean to each side with your arms overhead to stretch your waist and free up your ribs.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Reach both arms overhead and hold one wrist with the other hand.
Lean slowly to one side and keep both feet pressed into the floor.
Hold 15 seconds, switch sides, and do 2 sets on each side.
mistakes: Leaning forward or twisting instead of bending straight to the side.
Pushing the hips far out to the side.
standing_side_stretch.tip: Imagine you are standing between two walls, so you can only move sideways.

step_ups.title: Step-Ups
step_ups.desc: Step up and stand tall, then lower slowly, to build single-leg strength and balance.
steps: Stand in front of a step or a sturdy low bench.
Place one whole foot on the step and push up until you stand tall.
Lower the other foot back to the floor slowly.
Do 8 reps on each leg and rest, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Pushing off hard with the foot on the floor.
Dropping down fast instead of lowering with control.
step_ups.tip: Use a step that cannot slide or tip, and start low before you go higher.

superman.title: Superman
superman.desc: Lift your arms and legs off the floor to strengthen the back muscles that hold your posture.
steps: Lie face down with your arms reaching forward.
Lift your arms and legs slightly off the floor.
Keep your neck long, look at the floor and hold 2 seconds.
Lower slowly, 8 reps per set, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Forcing your chest and legs up as high as you can.
Tilting your head up and squeezing your neck.
superman.tip: A small lift is enough. If your lower back pinches, lift less.

steps: Warm up for 5 minutes with easy laps or light dribbling.
Swim or play for at least 30 minutes at a steady pace.
Reach fully on every stroke, shot or rebound.
Cool down with 5 minutes of easy movement and stretching.
mistakes: Skipping the warm-up and starting at full speed.
Forgetting to drink water while you play.
swimming_basketball.tip: Bring a friend; sport is easier to keep up when it is social.

table_top.title: Reverse Table Top
table_top.desc: Lift your hips into a flat table to open your chest and shoulders and strengthen your back side.
steps: Sit with your knees bent, feet flat and hands on the floor behind your hips.
Point your fingers toward your feet and press into your hands and feet.
Lift your hips until your body is flat from knees to shoulders.
Hold 15 seconds and lower, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag in the middle.
Dropping the head back so the neck strains.
table_top.tip: Turn your fingers out to the sides if your wrists feel sore.

thoracic_extension.title: Chair Upper-Back Extension
thoracic_extension.desc: Lean your upper back over a chair to undo the slouch from sitting and open your chest.
steps: Sit on a sturdy chair with the top of its back just below your shoulder blades.
Put your hands behind your head and keep your elbows wide.
Lean your upper back slowly over the chair back and look up.
Come back up, do 8 reps and rest, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Bending from the lower back instead of the upper back.
Pulling the head forward with the hands.
thoracic_extension.tip: Use a chair that cannot roll or tip, and keep your feet flat on the floor.

toe_touch.title: Toe Touch
toe_touch.desc: A slow forward fold that loosens the back of your legs and keeps your spine flexible.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your knees soft.
Fold forward from your hips and let your hands reach toward your toes.
Hold still for 20 seconds and breathe slowly.
Roll up slowly, rest, and repeat once more.
mistakes: Bouncing to reach further.
Locking your knees straight.
toe_touch.tip: If you cannot reach your toes, stop at your shins. It still works.

tuck_jumps.title: Tuck Jumps
tuck_jumps.desc: Jump and pull your knees up for explosive power, the hard effort your body answers with growth hormone afterwards.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Dip into a quick quarter squat and jump as high as you can.
Pull both knees toward your chest at the top, then land softly on bent knees.
Do 6 jumps, rest, and repeat for 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Bending your chest down to your knees instead of lifting the knees.
Landing hard with straight legs.
tuck_jumps.tip: Reset your balance between jumps, and make sure you have clear space and a floor that does not slip.

upward_salute.title: Upward Salute
upward_salute.desc: Reach up with your ribs down to open your chest and stand at your full height.
steps: Stand with your feet together and your arms by your sides.
Breathe in and reach both arms up over your head.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold 15 seconds, breathing slowly, then lower your arms. 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Leaning back and arching your lower back.
Letting your ribs push forward.
upward_salute.tip: Reach up, not back. Keep your body stacked over your feet.

wall_angels.title: Wall Angels
wall_angels.desc: Slide your arms along a wall to open your chest and train upright shoulders.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall, feet a little in front of you.
Put your arms on the wall with your elbows bent, like a goalpost.
Keep your ribs down and slowly slide your arms up, then back down.
Do 8 slow reps per set, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Letting your ribs flare and your lower back arch.
Letting your arms come off the wall.
wall_angels.tip: Only go as high as your arms can stay on the wall. It gets easier with practice.

wall_dog.title: Wall Dog
wall_dog.desc: A standing stretch at the wall that opens your shoulders and keeps your spine long.
steps: Stand facing a wall, about one leg length away.
Put your hands on the wall at hip height.
Hinge back from your hips until your arms are straight and your spine is long.
Hold 20 seconds, breathing slowly, 2 sets in total.
mistakes: Rounding your upper back.
Bending your elbows and leaning on the wall.
wall_dog.tip: A great break at your desk when you cannot get on the floor.

wall_sit.title: Wall Sit
wall_sit.desc: Sit against a wall with your thighs level to build leg strength with your back held straight.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a step in front of you.
Slide down until your thighs are level with the floor.
Keep your knees above your ankles and your whole back on the wall.
Hold 20 seconds and stand up, 3 sets in total.
mistakes: Resting the hands on the thighs.
Letting the knees drift forward past the toes.
wall_sit.tip: Sit a little higher if your knees complain, and go lower as you get stronger.

steps: Stand with your heels against a wall, feet hip-width apart.
Touch your buttocks, shoulder blades and the back of your head to the wall.
Tuck your chin slightly and keep your arms relaxed at your sides.
Hold for 5 minutes, breathing calmly through your nose.
mistakes: Arching your lower back far away from the wall.
Pushing your chin up instead of keeping it level.
wall_stand.tip: Notice how this feels, then try to carry it into your day.
